info.name: KMS (Kaizen Management System) API
info.description:
Complete Postman API Collection for Kaizen Management System (KMS).
Includes Authentication, User, HR, Admin, Manager, and Director operations.
Features pre-configured bearer token propagation, sample payloads, and Super Admin limitations.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Profile
item.description: Authentication, device token registration, departments, and profile endpoints

request.description: Authenticates any active user (Admin, HR, User, Director, Manager). Automatically stores token in collection variable 'token'.
Registers device token for push notifications
